name: Whitespace-tolerant word list (\w+\s?)*

fix.summary: Because \s? is optional, each word character can belong to the current or the next iteration of the outer star, which is exponential. ^\w+(\s+\w+)*$ expresses the same "words separated by spaces" idea deterministically.

description: A deceptively innocent "one or more words, optional spaces" pattern. The optional \s? inside a starred group is a textbook ReDoS mistake.
